question: From which of the following countries did India adopt the ‘amendment procedure in the constitution’?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**South Africa**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India adopted the **procedure for amending the constitution from South Africa.**
 
• **The Indian Constitution's Article 368 i**s based on **Article 74(1) of the South African Constitution.**
 
• This **article states that a two-thirds majority of the members of Parliament can amend the Constitution**, as long as the amendment doesn't go against the Constitution's fundamental principles.
